why: The PURE half of the demonstrable pair (#1251 slice 3). This asset is the ONLY contributor to post 96ecc77c 'Tile 0422 (raster) — lighting pass' and belongs to no other post, so declaring it `generated` derives ai_pure=true on exactly one post and nothing else moves. Verified against a seeded instance: contributor count 1, asset used by 1 post.

The MIXED half. Post e0b87570 'Tile 0020 (raster) — 2-part set' has two contributors; this one is declared and c2b56d4d is deliberately left UNDECLARED, so the post reads ai_provenance='generated' (it does contain AI) and ai_pure=false (it is not entirely AI) — and therefore SURVIVES the hide toggle. That is the owner's ruling made visible in one flip beside the pure post above. This asset is unique to this post; the undeclared sibling is shared with one other post and is left alone precisely so nothing else moves.
